standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of a divided power structure
standard_prerequisites.use: Conditions (1)-(5), especially (3) and (4) for the uniqueness expansion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Generator criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the flat-case construction to a full divided power structure on IB.

standard_prerequisites.name: Lazard's theorem
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes flat B as a directed colimit of finite free modules, organizing the well-definedness of the flat-case construction. A footnote gives the alternative via algebra-lemma-flat-eq.

core_obligations: Uniqueness: expand an arbitrary finite sum representation of elements of IB with axioms (3) and (4).
Case I principal: define gamma_n(bx) = b^n gamma_n(x); prove well-definedness using that gamma_n(x) is divisible by x; verify axioms (1)-(5) with (4) displayed via the binomial expansion.

Case A -> B flat: define gamma_n on IB by the multi-variable expansion; prove well-definedness via Lazard's theorem (footnote: alternative by algebra-lemma-flat-eq); close axioms (1), (3), (4) by construction and (2), (5) by the generator criterion.
proof_roadmap: Prove uniqueness by the axiom expansion, then run the three existence cases: trivial, principal with the explicit well-definedness computation, and flat with the Lazard-organized expansion.
difficulty_reason: Three separate existence constructions with real verifications (the principal well-definedness and the flat-case coefficient matching); the footnote alternative must be reproduced honestly.
